observations: The top holds again: Steal An Egg (99 days), Brookhaven, DONT SPLASH (15 days), RIVALS, 99 Nights in the Forest and Murder Mystery 2 lead the pillar.
Climbers were young story and simulator games plus an evergreen road trip: Say Cheese! [STORY] +19 at 13 days, Southern Mudding +15, a dusty trip +11, Throw Food For Animals +11 and +1 Anime Eyes +9.

Horror slid on the first day after Halloween: It Hears The Water [DONT SPLASH] -26, Scary Shawarma Kiosk: the ANOMALY -26 (reversing yesterday's +43) and A Long Flight [HALLOWEEN] -14; My Small Business (-10) and Realistic Car Destruction (-11) also fell.

Seven games entered, among them +1 Spider Arm (13 days), Ragdoll Playground (35 days), Scare Your Neighbor (30 days), Climb The Locust Tower (29 days) and the 586-day Grow a Garden; seven left, including Banana Eats, Murder Duels and Hide to Steal Eggs.

By age, 85-122-day games sit at the 67th median percentile and multi-year evergreens at the 55th, against 42nd-45th for 15-84-day games; the mid-life trough (H-mp-009 at 48%) is not visible today with only ten 4-12-month games.
patterns: Recent updates tend to go with more days on the chart: games left more than 22 days without one stay fewer days (r=-0.57), though H-mp-006 on position fell from 75% to 64%.

Pricing tends to go with staying power: median products above 400 R$ split days on the chart at r=+0.50 and median passes above 79 R$ at r=+0.41 (H-mp-011, H-mp-016 at 65%); the 149 R$ pass-price rule weakened to 49%.
More original concepts consistently hold higher positions (H-mp-013 at 75%), and incremental '+1' loops sit at the 73rd median percentile among the five profiled, driven by young games still rising.
Big evergreens consistently convert fewer visits into favorites (H-mp-010 at 80%; fav_per_kvisit vs days on chart rho=-0.42), so a high favorite rate marks a young game, not a durable one.
Collect-upgrade-rebirth (16th percentile), wave-survival co-op (30th) and idle tycoons (29th) trail PvP, steal-defend and job sims (60th-66th), though each group has only three or four games.

outliers.name: Scary Shawarma Kiosk: the ANOMALY
outliers.note: Swung from +43 to -26 in a day; its Halloween update lifted it for the event only, consistent with H-x-027 but one game cannot separate the event's end from ordinary churn.

outliers.name: 📸 Say Cheese! [STORY]
outliers.note: The biggest riser at 13 days with no passes and four products; a story game climbing on Most Popular breaks the usual pattern that monetized simulators lead young climbers.

outliers.name: [🎃] Grow a Garden 🌶️
outliers.note: Re-entered at 586 days with 300 products and no passes, a former breakout returning on an update rather than a slow fade.

observations: Donation hubs again top efficiency (Summer Donations, Donation Central, Simple DONATIONS), followed by Build and Burn (27 days), Elemental Dungeons and Dinosaur Simulator.
The least efficient remain high-CCU breakouts or horror: Flee the Facility, DONT SPLASH, Bike For Egg! and Throw Food For Animals.

+1 Anime Eyes climbed 206, +1 Titan Evolution 173, Iron Soul: Dungeon 160, Throw Food For Animals 156 and THA BRONX 3 150; Build a PC (-138), Don't Steal My Eggs! (-110) and Run an Airline (-103) fell most.

Thirty games entered (Those Who Remain at 3,721 days, Attack on Titan Revolution, Supernatural Realm, Scare Your Neighbor, Ragdoll Playground among them) and twenty-nine left, including Car Sales 2, Steal the Moon and Clean all the Leaves.
Efficiency rises with age, from the 3rd median percentile at 0-14 days and the 21st at 15-42 days to the 63rd past a year (H-te-001 at 84%).
patterns: High prices consistently pay: median products above 79 R$ (r=+0.47), a pass above 699-999 R$ and median passes above 399 R$ all hold at 87% (H-te-005, H-te-006, H-te-025).
RPGs (r=+0.46), roleplay hubs (+0.32) and more complex builds (rho=+0.29) consistently earn more per player, while Survival (-0.36), Simulation (-0.28) and solo loops (-0.29) consistently earn less.
Steal-and-defend-base loops are the weakest earners per player (r=-0.59, 16th percentile; H-te-024 at 87%), and 'Egg' titles split efficiency at r=-0.81.

Physics sandboxes sit at the 7th median percentile across ten games, the lowest of any loop; with the ragdoll wave filling the breakout charts, a test is proposed today that these games earn little per player.
Tower-defense loops consistently earn more per player (H-te-044 up to 83%), and servers above about 40 players split efficiency at r=+0.40, in line with H-te-007.

outliers.name: [CHAPTER 3] Build and Burn
outliers.note: Among the most efficient earners at 27 days with one pass and a 74% like ratio, against the rule that efficiency comes with age; a chapter-based drag racer selling cash and timed multipliers to a small, invested audience is the likely reason.

outliers.name: [🌍UPD] +1 Anime Eyes
outliers.note: Climbed 206 places at 18 days, the clearest case of revenue catching up with a breakout's players (H-te-018 at 55%), though a '+1' template still earns little per player (H-te-004 at 84%).

outliers.name: Flee the Facility
outliers.note: The least efficient earner at 3,410 days with one pass; an old horror classic with a huge free audience shows that age alone does not lift efficiency when the catalogue is thin.

observations: Obbies and ragdoll sandboxes lead momentum: Push the Patient (42 days, +29), Scary Baboon Reimagined, Realistic Ragdoll Playground (15 days), Fart Together (+19), TROLL Jail Hug Tower and Ragdoll Playground.

Durian Garden climbed 24 at 11 days and Pet Simulator 99 21 on a minigames update; horror led the fallers: WARDEN -60, Survive the Killer! -38, Scary Shawarma Kiosk -31, It Hears The Water -19 and The Mimic -14.

Twenty games entered, including MALAM SAMA OPAH (12 days), Evermore High, Make Viral Candy! (14 days), Survive a Million Monkeys and the older a dusty trip, Attack on Titan Revolution and Ink Game; twenty left, Dead Rails, Violence District and Bike For Egg! among them.
Momentum falls with age: the 63rd median percentile at 0-14 days, 55th at 15-42 days, 41st at 43-84 days and 24th at 85-122 days (H-tt-001 at 61%).
patterns: 'Ragdoll' titles split momentum at r=+0.71 and sandbox-physics loops sit at the 74th percentile, the strongest keyword signal on the chart (H-x-021 at 70%).
Selling spins or crates goes with higher positions within age (+0.46), while a skill-based competitive core goes with lower positions (r=-0.43) and slower climbs (-0.38); both are tested from today.
Frequent updates consistently go with higher positions (H-tt-040 at 70%), and servers above 24 players consistently go with lower positions among young games (H-tt-049 at 70%).
Gameplay thumbnails consistently go with higher positions (H-tt-029 at 70%) while character-art thumbnails tend to climb more slowly (H-tt-044 at 60%).
Grow-a-garden mechanics go with higher positions (r=+0.44, 8 games) and obby-genre games climb faster within age (+0.34); the garden test is proposed today.

outliers.name: [1-2 PLAYER OBBY] Push the Patient
outliers.note: The top climber at 42 days, past the 6-week cut where momentum usually fades (H-tt-001); a two-player co-op obby with only three passes and four products suggests format, not monetization, drives it.

outliers.name: WARDEN 🐲 Sonaria Horror Escape
outliers.note: Fell 60 places a day after entering Most Popular; a horror spin-off of an established creature game appears to have peaked with Halloween.

outliers.name: 🎃 [MINIGAMES] Pet Simulator 99! 👻
outliers.note: A 1,730-day game climbed 21 on a minigames update; it is outside the age window for the pillar but shows how updates resurface evergreens on Top Trending.

observations: +1 Spider Arm (13 days), DONT SPLASH, The Hollow, Say Cheese! [STORY], Bug Evolution and MALAM SAMA OPAH lead the chart.

Make Viral Candy! climbed 44 at 14 days, Tesla Roadster Chase 43 at 11 days, Clean the Moon! 31, Destroy Verity 27 and Fart Together 24; It Hears The Water (-28), Teach Your Sister How To Drive! (-27) and UNDERTALE Fight! (-25) fell most.

Fourteen games entered, three of them profiled as sandboxes (Ragdoll Sandbox, Ragdoll Physics 2, Make a Cartoon!), plus Can You Pass A Driving Test?, Ice Cream Shop [Anomaly], Pixel Arena and Punch Walls To Escape; thirteen left, including +1 Titan Evolution and Flying Tesla Roadster.
The newest games dominate: 0-14-day games sit at the 87th median percentile against the 47th for 15-42-day games (H-uc-005 at 63%).
patterns: Collect-upgrade-rebirth loops tend to rank lower (r=-0.57, within-age -0.62, 13th percentile; H-uc-050 at 66%): the punch-and-click escape incrementals sit at the bottom of the chart.
Steal mechanics rank higher (r=+0.50, 8 games; H-uc-002 at 68%) and survival framing consistently ranks higher (H-uc-047 at 75%), while cash-tycoon loops consistently rank lower (H-uc-016 at 76%).
More original concepts consistently rank higher within age (H-uc-039 at 76%), and recent updates consistently go with higher positions (H-uc-012 at 73%).
Update tags in the title go with higher positions within age (+0.34) even though bracket tags in general tend to go with lower ones (H-uc-004 at 65%); a separate update-tag test is proposed today.
Luck passes consistently go with lower positions (H-uc-018 at 73%), and asking players to like the game consistently goes with higher ones (H-uc-042 at 72%).

outliers.name: The Hollow
outliers.note: Third on the chart at 19 days with no passes and no products; the Roblox-run event (H-x-020) carries it without any monetization.

outliers.name: Make Viral Candy! 🍬
outliers.note: Climbed 44 at 14 days with 17 passes, 102 products and RNG framing, against the luck-pass and cash-tycoon rules (H-uc-018, H-uc-016); a viral-candy theme likely outweighs the template.

outliers.name: Punch Out Of Prison
outliers.note: Among the weakest despite a fresh Chapter 2, a Halloween event and 10 badges; the collect-upgrade-rebirth loop (H-uc-050) appears to cap its position.

summary: Ragdoll physics is now the widest wave: Ragdoll Playground reached Most Popular, Top Earning, Top Trending and Up-and-Coming at once, two more ragdoll sandboxes entered Up-and-Coming, and H-x-021 rises to 70%; yet sandbox loops sit at the 7th percentile on Top Earning, the same reach-without-revenue split as the steal/egg template (H-x-002) and Simulation (H-te-027 at 87%).

Halloween ended and horror led the falls on three charts (WARDEN, Survive the Killer!, It Hears The Water, Scary Shawarma Kiosk); H-x-027 rises to 32% pending the rest of the week, and H-x-019 eases to 52% as DONT SPLASH holds while its spin-off drops.

Revenue keeps lagging popularity: +1 Anime Eyes, +1 Titan Evolution and Throw Food For Animals each climbed 150+ places on Top Earning (H-te-018 at 55%), while efficiency still rises steadily with age (H-te-001 at 84%).

A skill-based competitive core tends to go against breakout (Top Trending -0.43, Up-and-Coming -0.27) while PvP combat consistently earns more per player on Top Earning (H-te-022 at 87%): competition looks like a monetization engine, not a launch engine.

No gameplay videos were labelled for the third day: Dragon Adventures, Creatures of Sonaria, Sol's RNG and Basketball: Zero are marked frames_ready but arrived with zero frames. No new outside research was waiting.
progressions: uc→tt remains the most common transition (156 entries, median 2 days), ahead of tt→mp (135, 2 days).
uc→te (108, 5 days), tt→te (101, 4 days), uc→mp (87, 4 days) and te→tt (79, 9 days) keep showing breakouts reaching revenue and dominance within about a week, while tt→uc stays at 1.
Ragdoll Playground (35 days) now sits on all four charts, entering Most Popular and Top Earning on the same day while holding Up-and-Coming #7 and Top Trending #19.
